limits.label: Largest single order
limits.protects: Caps one bad decision. Nothing the agent does can risk more than this at once.

limits.label: Largest position in one market
limits.protects: Stops the agent concentrating everything in a single market.

limits.label: Total exposure across all markets
limits.protects: Bounds total risk even if every individual order is small.

limits.label: Daily loss limit
limits.protects: Halts the agent for the day once losses reach this, rather than letting a bad day compound.

limits.label: Consecutive losing trades
limits.protects: Halts the agent when it is repeatedly wrong, which usually means conditions changed.

limits.label: Actions per minute
limits.protects: A runaway guard. A loop that misfires cannot spend the account in seconds.
